Modest forward lean from ankles, head consistent size, hips connected to thighs, elbows wrist continuity, hair/clothing trail. All motion genuinely drawn new poses; NO rotated cutout look. Attack and skill rows stationary feet anchored; faces hair and clothing identity constant.
